zh.title: 波音737 MAX 7小型客機正式獲認證 暫不立即投入營運
zh.summary: 波音737 MAX 7客機獲認證；暫不立即投入營運；主要將由西南航空營運。
body: 據 Simple Flying 報導，波音公司（Boeing）旗下民航機產品線中最小型的機型 737 MAX 7，目前已正式獲得航空監管機構認證。然而，取得這項關鍵認證並不意味著 737 MAX 7 機型會立即投入客運服務。
根據過往公開紀錄顯示，波音公司先前暫未向歐洲航空安全組織申請該機型的相應認證。該款客機未來預計將幾乎完全由美國西南航空（Southwest Airlines）負責營運。波音先前預估在 2026 年取得認證後，首批機隊將於 2027 年展開交付。

en.title: Boeing 737 MAX 7 Receives Certification But Will Not Enter Service Immediately
en.summary: Boeing 737 MAX 7 achieves certification; entry into service not immediate; aircraft destined mainly for Southwest Airlines.
body: According to a report from Simple Flying, Boeing's smallest variant in the 737 MAX family, the 737 MAX 7, has officially achieved certification. However, securing official certification from regulators does not mean that the single-aisle aircraft will enter commercial revenue service immediately.

According to historical aviation records, Boeing previously chose not to pursue certification approval for the 737 MAX 7 from European regulatory authorities at this stage. The aircraft model will be operated almost entirely by Southwest Airlines. Furthermore, Boeing had previously stated in July that it anticipated receiving official certification in 2026, with the first delivery expected to take place in 2027.

zh.title: 美海軍發布 RFI 徵求艦載作戰無人機計畫
zh.summary: 海軍徵求兩架原型機，外掛最多一萬磅武器，成本上限三千萬美元
body: 美國海軍航空系統司令部於 2026 年 8 月 31 日發布資訊請求（RFI），為協同作戰飛機（CCA）計畫首階段尋求兩架全功能原型機。
需相容 Gerald R. Ford 級與 Nimitz 級航艦彈射與攔截系統，外掛四枚最重 2,500 磅武器，總負載上限 10,000 磅，單機成本不超過 3,000 萬美元。
無人機將使用現有 MD-5 無人艦載航空任務控制系統（原為 MQ-25 加油機開發），並預期與 F/A‑18E/F、F‑35C 及未來 F/A‑XX 共同執行任務。

en.title: U.S. Navy issues RFI for carrier‑based collaborative combat drones with 10,000‑lb payload
en.summary: Navy seeks two prototype carrier drones, 10,000‑lb external load, $30M cost target
body: The U.S. Naval Air Systems Command issued a request for information on 31 August 2026 for the first increment of the Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) programme, seeking two fully functional prototype uncrewed combat aircraft capable of operating from aircraft carriers.

The prototypes must be compatible with both Gerald R. Ford‑class and Nimitz‑class carriers, including catapult launch and arrested recovery, carry up to four external stores of 2,500 lb each for a maximum 10,000 lb payload, and meet an affordability ceiling of $30 million per airframe.

They will employ the existing MD‑5 Unmanned Carrier Aviation Mission Control System, originally developed for the MQ‑25 Stingray, and are envisioned to operate alongside F/A‑18E/F Super Hornets, F‑35C Lightning IIs and the future F/A‑XX sixth‑generation fighter.

zh.title: 利雅德航空首架A321neo進入最終組裝
zh.summary: 利雅德航空首架A321neo於漢堡進行最終組裝
body: 利雅德航空公開其首架空中巴士A321neo的最終組裝照片，組裝地點位於德國漢堡的空中巴士廠區。
照片於2026年9月2日發布，畫面中可見該機尾翼已塗上利雅德航空塗裝，周圍為空中巴士設備。
這架A321neo將搭載CFM國際LEAP-1A引擎，空中巴士預計將在年底前交付首架。
利雅德航空於2024年10月宣布採購60架A321neo。除A321neo外，該公司亦已訂購787-9與A350-1000客機。

en.title: Riyadh Air shares photos of first Airbus A321neo during final assembly
en.summary: Riyadh Air's first A321neo in final assembly at Hamburg; LEAP-1A engines; delivery expected by end of 2026
body: Riyadh Air has shared photos of its first upcoming Airbus A321neo during final assembly at the planemaker's Hamburg facility in Germany.
The two pictures, posted on September 2, 2026, show the single-aisle jet with its tail painted in Riyadh Air colors, surrounded by Airbus equipment.
The aircraft will be powered by CFM International LEAP-1A engines. The first A321neo is expected to be delivered before the end of the year.
Riyadh Air announced in October 2024 that it would purchase 60 A321neo aircraft. The company has also ordered Boeing 787-9s and 31 Airbus A350-1000s.
